capabilities: Customize independent text and background palettes
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or later; no build step; makes no network requests and stores settings locally; complex HTML and code are not supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to color selected text or apply custom-colored background highlights while editing.
summary: Editor plugin that applies and removes text and background colors using inline HTML spans with customizable palettes.
